title: Sulfur cube redstone block
description: Allows you to place redstone blocks in sulfur cubes, and have them power adjacent redstone components! Inspired by the latest PhoenixSC video.
body: # Overview - Sulfur cubes with redstone blocks in them now gaslight other blocks into thinking there is an actual redstone block at that position! - Not much else to say lol # Final notes - Join the discord server to suggest features and report bugs.
